reviews.author: Priyanka Sharma
reviews.excerpt:
Its been 3 months of getting our puppy home and we are so happy that we trusted Dr Gaurav with his vaccinations and also for his allergies, guidance on food and recently when he happened to have a limp in his leg. The staff is sweet and the doctor is amazing. He is genuine and empathetic and has good diagnosis and support. Yes, there is a bit of waiting involved and some time coordination but its also because of the surgeries, emergencies and a lot of patients visiting. But after you meet doctor, its such a relief! And he is also our puppy's favourite🤞🏻🧿

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dr. Shraddha Panchal
reviews.excerpt: I have worst experiences over and over again. The main vet doctor is never at the clinic. The staff is incompetent and doesn’t communicate well. Makes you wait for a long time. They lure you to come after making a call but either the medicines aren’t available nor the doctor is late to arrive. Being a doctor myself, I have shared my experiences to Dr. Gaurav before, but similar experiences happen again and again. Not anymore. I choose not to waste my time and efforts even thinking to visit them.

reviews.author: Minal Mankar
reviews.excerpt:
About 3 months ago, our 3-month-old puppy Mylo swallowed a large mutton bone from the trash. An initial X-ray at another hospital showed it was stuck in his throat near the neck. He was vomiting and not eating anything, and as time passed, he started breathing strangely, almost as if he was choking. We were extremely worried.

Through a common friend, we connected with Dr. Gaurav at Suyash Pet Clinic, Chembur. Even before we visited, he stayed in constant touch over the phone and guided us calmly. At the clinic, he immediately attended to Mylo, started him on saline, and did another X-ray. He clearly explained the situation, the size of the bone, the endoscopy procedure, and all associated risks, while also reassuring us throughout.

What truly stood out was his patience, kindness, and genuine care—not just for Mylo, but for us as anxious pet parents. He did everything he could to avoid surgery, and thankfully, the endoscopy was successful. Mylo recovered well, and we couldn’t be more grateful.

We had visited another hospital before this and felt very unsure due to their lack of clarity and significantly higher costs. In such emergencies, having a doctor who is both skilled and empathetic is truly a blessing.

Highly recommend Suyash Pet Clinic and Dr. Gaurav without hesitation. Writing this review after 2+ months, with a happy and healthy Mylo ❤️

reviews.author: prasenjeet gaikwad
reviews.excerpt: Truly the best vet in the area. My 4 month old kitten (Ruby) was at a point where she wasn't responding and had a dangerously low WBC of 1.2. Thanks to the expert care and intensive treatment provided by Dr. Gaurav and Dr. Krishna, she made a full recovery. If your pet is in a critical situation, don't go anywhere else. This clinic saves lives.
